class D:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c):
        self.a = a
        self.b = b
        self.c = c


class M:
    def __init__(self, x):
        self.x = set(x)
        self.y = {}

    def f(self, a, b, c):
        if a not in self.x:
            raise ValueError('no')
        self.x.remove(a)
        r = D(a, b, c)
        self.y[a] = r
        return r

    def g(self, a):
        r = self.y.pop(a)
        self.x.add(a)
        return r

    def h(self, t):
        return sorted((r for r in self.y.values() if t > r.c), key=lambda r: r.c)
